messages.subject: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear colleagues at Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH,

Thank you for your letter and for setting out your position.

Even taken at face value, the figures you gave us - AS-14404 +5.9% at 45% of your cost, LCI-C +2.7% at 5% of your cost, PPI-C2431 +12.3% at 38% of your cost - explain at most about +7.5% on the price, not the 11.01% you ask for. Your on-time delivery over the last four quarters was 88.0% (sc:70710@2026Q3).

The data does not support your price as it stands.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 4.63 per unit, payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.
Option B: EUR 4.57 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.
Option C: EUR 4.58 per unit, payment 45 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.

Could you share a cost breakdown for this part - material, conversion, overhead?

We look forward to your revised offer.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

We appreciate your detailed review and are willing to extend the agreement to 24 months to support your long-term planning. As we cannot offer a fixed price over a 24-month period, we must include an AS-14404 index clause to manage material volatility.

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €5.47 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

With this adjustment to a 24-month indexed contract and 30-day payment terms, we can offer a revised price of €5.52 per unit. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.52 per unit.

We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

Logistics: Our Lieferzeit is 10 days. We are well loaded, but with overtime we can deliver in 10 days, at a premium.

Dear colleagues at Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH,

Thank you for your message and for telling us what matters to you.

Your latest offer is still 0.4% above today's price of EUR 5.45.

We are ready to move on the terms you care about if the price reflects it - each option below is a different trade, so you can choose what helps you most. We have taken your point on a fixed price: every option below includes an index clause. We would like to settle this in writing; the options below are our complete proposal.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 4.88 per unit, index clause on AS-14404 (45% material share, 5% deadband, base 2026-08), payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option B: EUR 4.77 per unit, index clause on AS-14404 (45% material share, 0% deadband, base 2026-08), payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option C: EUR 4.83 per unit, index clause on AS-14404 (45% material share, 3% deadband, base 2026-08), payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.

Which base month and deadband would you consider fair for an index clause?

Please tell us which option suits you best.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your willingness to incorporate the AS-14404 index clause into the 24-month agreement. Regarding your question, we consider a 0% deadband with the base month of August 2026 to be the most transparent and fair approach. In response to your improved offer, we can revise our price to EUR 5.39 per unit for this package. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. Furthermore, we can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. 

For this tailored Angebot, we propose a price of €5.39 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our great working relationship.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
